statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The 31,144.50 NQ session low has now held for a second consecutive hour and the retracement off it has extended to about 203 points at 31,347, holding the daily loss at 0.43% against 1.08% at the low. VIX eased further to 15.34 from 15.66 and the 10-year pared to 5.31% from its 5.36% session high, so Tail steps down to 18 and leaves the watch band: the shallow-pullback signature seen this morning has now clearly failed to persist. Stress stays elevated at 52 because yields near a 24-year high, negative breadth with the Russell 2000 down 1.30%, and Brent above $100 remain an unfriendly backdrop, and the 18:00Z FOMC minutes keep a credible unresolved mechanism open inside the published danger window.
recommendation: Tail is in the low band and below the block threshold on the current observed path. The narrow evidence-based danger window spans the 17:00Z 10-year note auction, the 18:00Z September FOMC minutes and the hours of possible delayed yield-led repricing into the 20:00Z cash close, where the published forecast reaches the elevated band for two slots before decaying.
headline: NQ holds its 31,144.50 low a second hour and extends the retracement to about 203 points, easing Tail to 18 as VIX slips to 15.34 ahead of the 18:00Z FOMC minutes
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade near 31,347, down 0.43% from the 31,483.25 close, inside a 31,144.50 to 31,521.00 session range after Tuesday's record cash close. The decisive development this hour is structural rather than directional: the 31,144.50 low set two hours ago has held, and the bounce off it has extended from about 154 points to about 203, so roughly 60% of the morning decline has been retraced. That is the opposite of the repeated-extension-after-failed-retracement pattern that defines Tail risk, and it is why Tail steps out of the watch band to 18 even though the backdrop has not improved. Cash NDX confirms the same path at 31,091, down 0.43%, having recovered from a 30,904.46 low. Volatility is decaying with it: VIX is 15.34 against a 16.01 session high. The pressure source remains the bond market. The 10-year is at 5.31% after touching 5.36% and the 30-year near 5.68%, which is compressing valuations most severely outside the megacaps, and breadth reflects that: the Russell 2000 is down 1.30% and more than 8% from its high, with decliners outpacing advancers by about 1.59 to one. Semiconductors are soft but orderly, with Micron down 1.77%, AMD down 1.28%, Broadcom down 1.31% and Nvidia down 0.74%. Oil is an added inflationary constraint, WTI near $88.90 and Brent at $100.76 on continuing Middle East supply concern. The September NY Fed survey published at 15:00Z showed one-year inflation expectations rising to 3.9% from 3.6%, the highest since May 2023, and notably it did not produce downside continuation, which is itself evidence that the current tape absorbs hawkish news. Three scheduled checkpoints remain: the 17:00Z 10-year auction, the 18:00Z minutes of the unanimous 15-16 September hike to 3.75-4.00%, and the 20:00Z cash close. The minutes are the one genuine multi-stage mechanism, because a bond reaction can lead a delayed equity second leg, and the published forecast reflects that conditionally rather than pre-emptively.

lookbackSummary: The last 24 published hours cover a complete regime round trip. The 6 October US afternoon and overnight session ran green with Tail compressing from 20 to a 10 to 13 range as a trend-up bias faded into mixed, two-way overnight trade. From 09:00Z on 7 October Tail began rising with the European session, reaching the watch band at 21 by 11:00Z and peaking at 23 at 14:00Z on a trend-down path as yields climbed toward a 24-year high and NQ printed four consecutive lower lows. The 15:00Z slot marked the turn: the session low held, Tail eased to 20 and the dominant mode returned to mixed. All 24 slots are available from published Claude history.
outlookSummary: The published forecast keeps Tail in the low band for the current hour on the observed retracement, then raises it through the scheduled checkpoint sequence: 20 into the 17:00Z auction, 23 for the 18:00Z FOMC minutes, and 25 for the 19:00Z and 20:00Z slots that would contain a delayed yield-led second leg and the cash close. Those two elevated slots are conditional protection against a specific mechanism, not a forecast that one-way structure has been observed. Tail then decays to the low band overnight, reaching 13 to 14 through the Asian session, and lifts again for the 08:30Z Waller speech, the 12:30Z jobless-claims print and the 13:30Z US cash open, which is the highest-value observation point in the window. Confidence drifts from 88 to 85 across the horizon as live price-path evidence ages.
